name: Matanuska-Susitna Borough, AK
findings: Matanuska-Susitna Borough has 250 nonprofit organizations. 111 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Matanuska-Susitna Borough has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Matanuska-Susitna Borough list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 151 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
